name: suprnova-lsp
description: VS Code client for the suprnova-lsp language server.

suprnova-lsp.server.path.description: Path to the suprnova-lsp executable. When set, the extension runs this executable with the lsp subcommand.

suprnova-lsp.server.extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables for the suprnova-lsp server process.

enumDescriptions: Process packages in batches to reduce peak memory. The editor may wait longer for initial indexing.
Prioritize faster indexing builds while allowing higher peak memory.
suprnova-lsp.indexing.performancePrefere.description: Controls which indexing performance trade-off suprnova-lsp should prioritize. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.indexing.packageBatchSize.description: Number of packages indexed together when the performance preference is lower-peak-memory. Smaller values usually reduce peak memory and make indexing slower. A value of 1 processes one package at a time when possible. This setting is ignored by faster-builds. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing it.

suprnova-lsp.cargo.target.description: Target triple used to filter Cargo metadata for analysis. When unset, suprnova-lsp uses the current rustc host target. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.cargo.allFeatures.description: Ask Cargo to enable all package features while resolving metadata for analysis. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.cargo.noDefaultFeatures.description: Ask Cargo to disable default package features while resolving metadata for analysis. Custom features are still enabled when configured. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.cargo.features.description: Additional Cargo features to enable while resolving metadata for analysis. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

path.description: Cargo workspace root path this override applies to. Relative paths are resolved against VS Code workspace folders.

target.description: Target triple used to filter Cargo metadata for this Cargo workspace. Use null to reset an inherited global target.

allFeatures.description: Ask Cargo to enable all package features for this Cargo workspace.

noDefaultFeatures.description: Ask Cargo to disable default package features for this Cargo workspace.

features.description: Additional Cargo features to enable for this Cargo workspace.

suprnova-lsp.cargo.overrides.description: Cargo metadata configuration overrides keyed by exact Cargo workspace root path. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.cfg.test.description: Enable the `test` cfg atom for workspace packages during semantic analysis. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.cfg.atoms.description: Additional custom cfg atoms to enable for Cargo packages during semantic analysis. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

enumDescriptions: Keep all package analysis data in memory.
Keep only workspace package analysis data in memory.
Keep workspace packages and local path dependencies in memory.
Keep workspace packages, local path dependencies, and direct dependencies in memory.
Offload every package that can be written to the package cache.
suprnova-lsp.cache.packageResidency.description: Controls which package analysis artifacts remain resident after indexing. Restart the suprnova-lsp server after changing this setting.

suprnova-lsp.diagnostics.onStartup.description: Run Cargo diagnostics once after a Rust project engine initializes.

suprnova-lsp.diagnostics.onSave.description: Run Cargo diagnostics after Rust files are saved.

suprnova-lsp.diagnostics.command.description: Cargo subcommand used for diagnostics. This must be a Cargo subcommand such as check or clippy, not an arbitrary shell command.

suprnova-lsp.diagnostics.cargoArguments.description: Extra Cargo-level arguments appended to cargo <diagnostics.command> --message-format=json for diagnostics.

suprnova-lsp.diagnostics.extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables for Cargo diagnostics. Use this for compiler flags such as { "RUSTFLAGS": "--cfg tokio_unstable" }.

workspaceRoot.description: Exact Cargo workspace root. Relative paths require exactly one editor workspace folder.

manifestPath.description: Owning package manifest, absolute or relative to workspaceRoot.

exportPath.description: Prepared rustdoc JSON file, absolute or relative to workspaceRoot.

itemPath.description: Fully qualified compiler item path, such as devlist::models::user::User.

suprnova-lsp.rustdoc.inputs.description: Import prepared rustdoc JSON declarations for explicitly selected models. Restart the Suprnova LSP server after changing these inputs or their exports. Macro changes are not automatically synchronized.

suprnova-lsp.rustdoc.automatic.description: Generate Suprnova APIs automatically from saved Rust, Cargo manifest/lock/config and toolchain files. Uses the selected installed toolchain without automatic installation. Pending, stale or failed passes preserve the last valid generated API. Changes require a server restart.

artifactRoot.description: Parent directory for isolated worker artifacts; relative paths resolve from each Cargo workspace.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --release -p suprnova-lsp && npm run test:e2e:prebuilt
scripts.test:e2e:prebuilt: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('out-unit', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run compile:unit && node --test out-unit/unit/*.test.js
